card.name: Punctuation just before a dose or value
card.fires_on: Opening parenthesis, comma or space right after a drug name or lab term, where a dose or number comes next. Common after erythromycin, creatinine clearance, and ALT.

modes.label: Parenthesis after drug
modes.description: An opening parenthesis right after a drug name, leading into a dose.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space after creatinine clearance or a dosing phrase, before the numeric value.

modes.label: List punctuation after lab term
modes.description: A comma or 'and' in a list of liver enzyme names.
